latest.name: Lumi v0.6.0 (Pre-review Build)
latest.body:
Public pre-review build for source verification and Mojang AppID review.

> **Note:** Microsoft sign-in is intentionally disabled in this pre-review build until Mojang approves Lumi's AppID. You can still inspect the launcher UI, manage instances/saves, browse Modrinth/CurseForge, and verify ownership-gate behavior.
>
> Lumi is an independent third-party launcher and is NOT an official Minecraft product, nor approved by or associated with Mojang Studios or Microsoft.

### Verification
Please verify file integrity against `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
